title: StudioChangeOpenResult
description: The answer to POST /lessons/:lessonId/facets/:facet/change (2.18.0): 201 when this call opened the draft, 200 when a draft was already open (the caller joins it).

baseVersion.description: The live (published) version the draft starts from.

draftVersion.description: The version number Publish will give the draft (baseVersion + 1).

run.description: The `edit` run that stands for the change.
